description: This file contains abstract and concrete classes related to object creation (activators) within the Orleans.Serialization framework, providing mechanisms to instantiate objects of generic types, including support for reference and value types.

classes.name: DefaultActivator`1
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a mechanism to create instances of type T using dynamically generated methods.

classes.name: DefaultReferenceTypeActivator`1
classes.description: A sealed class for creating instances of reference types, extending DefaultActivator.

classes.name: DefaultValueTypeActivator`1
classes.description: A sealed class for creating instances of value types, extending DefaultActivator.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes a Func<T> delegate to create new instances using IL emission for reference types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of type T, either via constructor delegate or uninitialized object as fallback.
